title: Verify: Object action state transition and inventory unit tests
description: Test performAction on all five key objects with the real scene.
acceptance_criteria: Computer, window and bookshelf set flags

steps.action: From createInitialState: performAction(bed,search) -> inventory ['old-key']; repeating keeps one item; (old-computer,search) -> flags.computer_on true; (window,inspect) -> flags.window_seen true; (bookshelf,search) -> flags.secret_door_open true; (door,leave) on fresh state returns identical state, after bed search sets flags.door_unlocked true.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/objectActions.test.ts
